description: Turns a matrix-encoded stereo pair back into four quadraphonic channels, with a mono subwoofer output alongside

params.text: Sets the level of every output; the middle of its travel is unity gain and full clockwise is 6dB above that
Trades level between the two front outputs and the two surround outputs; the middle gives both the same level, full anticlockwise leaves only the fronts and full clockwise only the surrounds

inputs.text: The left half of the matrix-encoded pair
The right half of the matrix-encoded pair

outputs.text: The front left channel recovered from the matrix
The front right channel recovered from the matrix
The surround left channel recovered from the matrix
The surround right channel recovered from the matrix
The average of the four recovered channels put through a pair of two-pole lowpass filters, at the corner chosen on the menu and after the level and balance controls
A five-channel polyphonic copy of the outputs, in the order front left, front right, surround left, surround right, subwoofer

notes: decoding runs on blocks of 64 samples, so the outputs lag the inputs by that much
the logic decoding mode adds level-dependent steering between opposite corners to widen the separation, and the maker marks it experimental
menu: Decoding Mode: QS / Quark Matrix Decode, QS / Quark Logic Decode (Experimental), SQ Matrix Decode (Experimental) — chooses the matrix the two inputs are decoded with
Sub Cutoff: Bypass, 60Hz, 70Hz, 80Hz, 90Hz, 100Hz, 110Hz, 120Hz — sets the corner of the filter on the subwoofer output; Bypass moves the corner to 20000Hz rather than removing the filter
